features.name: Self-Healing AI Code Gen
features.description: Generate → AST validate → dry-run (xvfb) → if fail: send error+code to AI → fix → retry (max 2x).

features.name: Manim Code Validator
features.description: AST-based validator checks syntax, forbidden imports (os/sys/subprocess), class structure, infinite loops, animation count.

features.name: Audio-Video Independence
features.description: Render produces visual-only clip. Audio TTS runs separately. FFmpeg compose_scene() merges at compose step using tpad freeze-frame.

features.name: Zombie Worker Protection
features.description: start.sh kills ALL stale worker.py processes via pgrep on stop. Prevents old workers from consuming queue jobs.

features.name: Regenerate Code Flow
features.description: Editable visualDesc in UI. Backend injects updated visualDesc into AI script. Sets status=rendering to trigger polling.

features.name: Stuck Scene Self-Healing
features.description: Polling endpoint auto-detects and recovers scenes stuck in 'rendering' > 5m due to missed Redis messages (e.g., during backend hot-reloads).
